messages:
support_amy: @sre - ACME reported repeated 503s starting ~18:02 UTC. They say requests hang and then the API returns 503. Customer impact: high (webhooks failing).

support_amy: Pasted the short request: large streaming prompt, ~60k tokens, embed+toolcall. They said it used model=redwood-llama-70b-quant.

customer_ops_tom: Their timeline: spike at 18:01, full outage by 18:04, intermittent 200s after 18:20. They captured a request id: req_7Z9A.

sre_lina: Can you attach runner logs and container status? Suspect GPU OOM or a kernel fault.

support_amy: Logs below (truncated):
```
[18:02:11 UTC] runner-3 | ERROR: upstream process exited unexpectedly (signal 6)
[18:02:11 UTC] kernel   | NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, pid=8421, Ch 00000040
[18:02:12 UTC] containerd| container "runner-3" exit code=137
[18:02:12 UTC] runner-3 | Fatal: cuda illegal memory access at 0x7fffa12b0000
[18:02:12 UTC] runner-3 | backtrace: /opt/infer/bin/runner(+0x1a3f2) [0x55a3a1a3f2]
[18:02:12 UTC] runner-3 | signal 6 (SIGABRT) at 0x00007f8c...
```

eng_oncall_raj: Xid 31 often indicates a GPU page fault or illegal memory access. Could be kernel/GPU driver or bad memory access in quantized kernel. Any recent deploys?

support_amy: We rolled a quant-change yesterday to the 70b-quant profile at 01:00 UTC. Canary looked fine. No infra driver changes.

sre_lina: Two quick asks: 1) repro steps (minimal request) 2) collect coredump and nvidia-smi topo info + dmesg. Also pin traffic away from runner-3.

support_amy: Repro snippet the customer used (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-llama-70b-quant","stream":true,"prompt":"<long 60k token prompt>","max_tokens":8192}'
```

eng_oncall_raj: Taking ownership. I will: 1) set fallback routing for model to redwood-70b-float for Acme, 2) drain runner-3, 3) collect coredump + run `nvidia-smi -q` and `dmesg | tail -n 200`.

incident-bot: @eng_oncall_raj assigned incident INC-2024-4867 to eng_oncall_raj

sre_lina: Also capture container startup flags (LD_PRELOAD, MALLOC_ARENA_MAX) — quant kernels sometimes trip on certain jemalloc configs.

eng_oncall_raj: quick findings after short triage: docker inspect shows restart_count=3, container logs show repeated SIGABRT. dmesg has repeated "NVRM: Xid 31" and a page fault trace. No OOM killer messages for host (no oom_reaper).

support_amy: Customer confirmed switching to smaller model (redwood-13b) removed the 503s for now.

sre_lina: That suggests model/kernel path hit a bad pattern under long stream + prefetch. Next steps: rollback quant-change for hot path, add an autosafe fallback to float model for longstream (>=50k tokens), and request infra to verify driver sanity.

eng_oncall_raj: I'll collect artifacts and open infra bug: attach /var/log/nvidia-installer.log + kernel version. Also will capture a reproducible request with smaller stim to try to repro locally.

support_amy: Logging repro steps sent to customer to attempt isolated run against dev cluster. Asking for request body and response ids.

customer_ops_tom: Customer provided 2 request ids where it happened: req_7Z9A and req_7Z9B. They will run the sanitized replay in dev env and share results.

sre_lina: If we can repro, plan is: a) bisect quant kernels -> revert if needed, b) add an immediate routing rule to avoid quant path for streaming >50k, c) increase coredump retention and collect GPU debug logs.

eng_oncall_raj: ETA: I'll have coredump + nvidia logs in 30m, and will flip routing rule in 15m. Marking incident as "in progress".

support_amy: Thx. Notifying CS about mitigation (fallback routing) and billing hold for affected window.

eng_oncall_raj: Done: routing rule applied, Acme traffic now on float-backup pool. Monitoring for errors (watching 5xx rate).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2024-4867 status -> in_progress (owner: eng_oncall_raj)

eng_oncall_raj: Follow-ups: capture pmap of runner process, check if quant kernel PR #3421 correlates, and schedule full rollback if repro confirmed.

sre_lina: Adding note: if we see repeated Xid 31 across multiple machines, escalate to NV support.

support_amy: Customer said post-fallback they're back to normal. Closing customer-facing alert, keeping incident open for root cause.

eng_oncall_raj: Will post root-cause and repro steps when we finish debug. For now: mitigation successful, owner is oncall.

support_amy: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
